propositions: Six tracker-sync verbs (`reconcile`, `jira-onboard`, `bridge-probe`, `bridge-status`, `bridge-fsck`, `purge-bridge`) leak internal mechanics; `bridge-status` and `purge-bridge` are dead code.
rebar core shells out to `gh` binary as a safety precondition, breaking portability for clients without GitHub Actions and creating a silent guard failure.
The `--mode` enum fuses two concepts (mutation scope and execution permission) that should be split into `--max-changes` and pause/resume flags.
The 106-line YAML push loop in the GHA workflow re-implements `_store/push.py` divergently and must be reconciled and deleted.
The unified surface must run identically across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab environments without vendor-specific variable reads.
Default behavior inverts between `reconcile` (dry-run) and `bridge sync` (mutate), requiring retirement without alias to prevent silent live mutations from stale callers.
